items.title: MECH-357 agent-directed hazard pursuit Stage-H retest (6th pressure candidate; 603s+directedness)
items.note: 6th and final pressure-mechanism candidate for the MECH-357 Stage-H readiness test. 603u = 603s + DIRECTEDNESS: keeps 603s mobile drift (env_drift_interval=1/prob=0.6) and adds hazard_agent_pursuit=0.9 (single isolated change vs 603s) so a moving hazard chases the agent's current cell, removing 603s's spawn-lottery confound (undirected drift -> exact tie G_H_INTACT=G_H_LESION=0.6667; 603t scheduled adjacency -> LESION ceiling 1.0). PRIMARY: G_H_INTACT>=2/3 AND G_H_INTACT_frac>G_H_LESION_frac; two-sided headroom guard self-routes a mis-calibrated pressure to substrate_not_ready_requeue. CLEARS MECH-357 re-derive brake (count=2: 603s 2026-08-10, 603t 2026-08-13): the 603t autopsy recommended_substrate_queue_entry names this exact build; env primitive hazard_agent_pursuit landed ree-v3 39b5ca8, Stage-H threading landed this session (intelligent-elgamal-222d2b). GOV-REUSE-1: agent-directed pursuit is a new manipulation in no recorded manifest -> ran fresh. 2.5c: runs under known DEGRADING defect SD-MECH303-THRESHOLD-SOURCING on causal_grid_world.py (non-blocking). The avoidance_efficacy eligibility-trace leak:learn imbalance is filed as a SEPARATE substrate_queue line item; it does not confound the G_H window (scaffold_floor covers Stage-H). items.title: MECH-266/SD-032a GOV-FANOUT-1 H1: affinity_input_cap sweep for external_task mode-occupancy (diagnostic)
items.note: GOV-FANOUT-1 leg H1 of pre-registered frozen-ledger question mech266_mode_arbitration_saturation (failure_autopsy_mech266-464e-467e-cluster_2026-08-13). DIAGNOSTIC (excluded from confidence scoring). Sweeps affinity_input_cap in [0.75,1.0,1.25,1.5,1.75] at EVAL time on clones of one trained curriculum agent per seed (cap read live at SalienceCoordinator.tick(); train cap held at 2.0 for comparability with the banked 464e/467e reference). DV = per-cap/per-arm fraction_in_external_task reported per-arm (NEVER min-across-the-sweep) via experiments/_lib/regime_occupancy_gate.py, PLUS the continuous pre-argmax operating_mode['external_task'] margin (probe/H2 recommendation) and mode-conditioned external_task dwell. Null: no cap yields per-arm occupancy in (0.1,0.9) on >=2/3 seeds. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout = per-cap occupancy across the [0.75,1.75] band; absent from all banked manifests (464e/467e ran only cap=2.0) -> run needed, not reanalyzable. RE-DERIVE BRAKE: MECH-266/SD-032a count=4 but NOT braked -- this is a diagnostic discriminating WHY the ceiling holds (H1 vs H2), which Step 2.5b exempts, and the cluster autopsy's own re-derive brake explicitly PERMITS this H1 leg (refusing only a naked 464f/467f same-question same-gate re-queue). STEP 2.5c: mode-governance-engagement substrate_queue entry is severity=corrupting / implemented_pending_validation and overlaps salience_coordinator.py, but its corrupting defect was the min()-measurement gate, RESOLVED by (b) regime_occupancy_gate.py (which this run CONSUMES); the cap_calibration probe found the substrate code sound ('no defect in either file'). This run IS that entry's sanctioned validation follow-on, so it is not blocked; governance should downgrade the entry severity once this + H2 land. Empirically confirmed pre-authoring: one-tick probe against the real SalienceCoordinator showed operating_mode['external_task'] = 0.0 at cap=None/dacc_pe=16 and 0.76-0.86 across the swept band, and that the live cap override lands at tick(). Successor-in-spirit to 464e/467e, NOT a supersede.

items.title: Uncensored survival-to-death fishtank, TRUE single-life design -- MULTI-SEED re-run of V3-EXQ-920 (explicit --seeds 0..7; supersedes 920's 1-of-8-seeds execution defect)
items.note: Re-run of V3-EXQ-920 with the SEED-COUNT WORKAROUND applied. V3-EXQ-920 FAILed for an execution/wiring reason only: its queue entry correctly declared "seeds": 8 but carried no "args", and experiment_runner.py's run_experiment() builds subprocess CLI args ONLY from the item's "args" field (raw_args = item.get('args', []))  -- the declarative "seeds" count feeds only the progress-bar denominator (_run_axis_count), never a --seeds CLI arg  -- so the driver's own argparse default (--seeds default=[0]) silently ran a SINGLE seed. n_uncensored_deaths_total=1 < MIN_UNCENSORED_DEATHS_TOTAL=4 -> load-bearing sufficient_uncensored_deaths FAIL. The one seed that ran behaved exactly as pre-registered (genuine health_depleted death at 1475 steps, pct_right_censored_pooled=0.0 -- literally zero censoring; the self-route label '...still_censoring_dominated' is a hardcoded else-branch string, NOT a measurement finding). Governance-ratified routing: failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-916-916a-917-920-fishtank-cluster_2026-08-12.md Target 4 (status confirmed, interactive AskUserQuestion gate 2026-08-12) recommends exactly this re-queue as V3-EXQ-920a with explicit "args":["--seeds",...]. THE ONLY CHANGE from 920 is the added "args" field; the driver script is byte-identical and unchanged. Workaround CONFIRMED by dry-run smoke (--dry-run --seeds 0 1 -> two 'Seed N Condition' boundaries and two 'verdict: PASS' lines, rc=0, z_goal_stream active_frac=0.998 no writer defect); the runner passes args verbatim so --seeds 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 executes all 8. This is the exact infra defect the autopsy identified; the general fix (enforce queue-declared seed count into --seeds, or fix the driver default) is governance's / a separate infra chip's to apply and is NOT re-proposed here. GOV-REUSE-1 (2.4): the decisive readout (a TRUE single-continuous-life uncensored survival-time distribution at n>=4) is recorded in NO existing manifest -- 920 produced n=1, every prior 906-lineage segment was capped at 500 steps -- not recoverable, run required. Re-derive brake (2.5b): claim_ids=[], N/A. Downstream: the multi-seed within-life descriptive trend analysis (chip-20260812-exq920-multiseed-degradation-retrospective) runs once this lands, and feeds the DV set + sleep cadence for the matched-arm causal follow-up (chip-20260814-queue-causal-sleep-matched-arm). Diagnostic; excluded from governance confidence/conflict scoring. Ethics preflight (2.6): all-false / allow -- pre-ethical V3 instrumentation, SENT-0 boundary, same design as 920/912 already adjudicated.
